blinding_guess.why: The bumper and the three cliff sensors are looked up by bare, unscoped sensor names through SensorManager::GetSensor(name), while only the IMU lookup is scoped to the model instance (world::<model name>::base_footprint::<imu_name>); with more than one Kobuki instance in a world the unscoped lookups are ambiguous and can bind to another instance's sensors or fail.

notes: Snapshot is the kobuki_desktop metapackage tree; the unit is kobuki_gazebo_plugins (Gazebo ModelPlugin GazeboRosKobuki). All five packet elements are Gazebo sensors consumed through the Gazebo C++ API (sensors::ContactSensor for the bumper, sensors::RaySensor for the cliff sensors, sensors::ImuSensor for the IMU), not ROS topics, so msg_type and definition_id are null and QoS is null (ROS 1). No rate is set; sensors are read on every world update (event::Events::ConnectWorldUpdateBegin, gazebo_ros_kobuki.cpp:84). Sensor names are not written in the code: they arrive at run time from SDF plugin elements bumper_name (loads.cpp:260-262), cliff_sensor_left_name (185-187), cliff_sensor_center_name (195-197), cliff_sensor_right_name (205-207) and imu_name (287-289), supplied by the robot model description (kobuki_description urdf/kobuki_standalone.urdf.xacro via kobuki_gazebo/launch/includes/robot.launch.xml:7, not in the snapshot); therefore none of the elements is placed in references. resource:cliff_sensor_front is mapped to the plugin's center cliff sensor, which the code calls the frontal cliff sensor (loads.cpp:201, gazebo_ros_kobuki.h:192). Lookup scoping: bumper and cliff sensors use sensors::SensorManager::Instance()->GetSensor(<bare name>) (loads.cpp:216, 218, 220, 271); the IMU uses sensors::get_sensor(world_->GetName()+"::"+node_name_+"::base_footprint::"+imu_name) (loads.cpp:298), where node_name_ is the model name (gazebo_ros_kobuki.cpp:56-58); the recorded IMU frame is the link name hard-coded in that scoped lookup, not a frame_id string. Bumper contact positions and normals are treated as world coordinates and rotated by the model world yaw (updates.cpp:274-288); no frame string is declared, so frame is null. Cliff units come from the header comment on cliff_detection_threshold_ ('measured distance in meter'), against which GetRange(0) is compared (updates.cpp:193). If any sensor is missing, Load logs ROS_ERROR and returns without retry (loads.cpp:221-235, 272-276, 299-303). The plugin commands the wheel joints (SetVelocity/SetMaxForce, updates.cpp:179-182) whose names come from SDF (left_wheel_joint_name/right_wheel_joint_name), but claims no resource exclusively. Interfaces outside the packet: publishes joint_states, odom, <base_prefix>/events/cliff, <base_prefix>/events/bumper, <base_prefix>/sensors/imu_data; subscribes <base_prefix>/commands/motor_power, /commands/reset_odometry, /commands/velocity; base_prefix is a private param with default mobile_base (loads.cpp:311-355). No dependency definition files were fetched because no packet element is a ROS message type.
